At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. The light rail crosses the river twice.
Little by little, things began to change. Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. On Monday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. The machine takes coins only.

People around Sam often share different ideas about the shopping mall. Sam ordered bread and juice at the cashier last night. Sam thanked Max for the honest advice. Also, deadstock fabric awaits rediscovery.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Earrings are non-returnable.
Max and Sam are preparing a report about the shopping mall. Sam will take part in a tennis match in January. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
